Hi, I'm Adrian!

A creative designer and problem-solver focused on developing thoughtful and visually compelling digital experiences and brands.

My Background

I fell in love with graphic design through my art classes in high school. I loved drawing and creating, but I ultimately found my passion in visual storytelling and using design to solve problems. I enjoy digging into the why behind a challenge just as much as crafting the final solution, whether that means refining a design system, shaping a brand's visual language, or polishing the small details that make an experience feel intentional.

As a fan of TV shows, books, and video games, storytelling and problem-solving sit at the core of my work. I am fascinated by how thoughtful design can guide someone, clarify an idea, and make an experience feel effortless.

Education

B.S. in Digital Communications and Creative Arts

Lebanon Valley College | Graduated 2022

My education gave me a strong foundation in visual design, typography, color theory, and concept development, while also encouraging experimentation and critical thinking. Through studio courses and collaborative projects, I learned how to translate ideas into visual systems and communicate effectively through design.
